sections.heading: Overview
bullets: An earth-themed fight built around pillar management, with an 8-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Pillars
bullets: Damaged pillars empower Adina: +20% of her outgoing damage and +20% damage reduction per stack — manage pillar damage deliberately rather than letting it happen incidentally.
Tectonic Upheaval raises a pillar that kills nearby players with its shockwave unless you jump over it.

sections.heading: Attacks
bullets: Boulder barrages and stalagmites that can't be evaded or blocked — get out of the way rather than trying to defend through them.
Diamond Palisade (Radiant Blindness) blinds anyone not facing away from her when it goes off — turn around for it.
She targets the highest-toughness player — plan positioning/roles with that in mind.
